## Build Failure Analysis

### Solution Structure
```
BuildDiag.sln
├── Core/Core.csproj        (net8.0, no package refs)
├── Services/Services.csproj (net8.0, references Core)
└── Api/Api.csproj          (net8.0, references Services + Core)
```

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` but `Services.csproj` has no PackageReference for it.**

Errors (all in `Services.csproj` build):
```
CS0246: The type or namespace name 'Newtonsoft' could not be found
  → UserService.cs(2,7)  — using Newtonsoft.Json;
  → UserService.cs(3,7)  — using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
  → UserService.cs(22,19) — JObject usage
```

The `project.assets.json` for Services confirms only `Core` is listed as a dependency — no `Newtonsoft.Json` package was restored.

### Cascading Failures

- **`Core.csproj` Build failure** — Core fails because `Services` (which depends on it) triggers re-evaluation chains that cascade upward through the solution's dependency graph.
- **`Api.csproj` ResolveProjectReferences failure** — Api depends on Services, so when Services fails to compile, Api cannot resolve its project references.

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix will resolve all 3 CS0246 errors and unblock the cascading failures in Api.
